documents.title: Create checkpoint permissions
documents.description: This enables organization owners to share fine-tuned models with other projects in their organization.

documents.title: Delete checkpoint permission
documents.description: Organization owners can use this endpoint to delete a permission for a fine-tuned model checkpoint.

documents.title: List checkpoint permissions
documents.description: Organization owners can use this endpoint to view all permissions for a fine-tuned model checkpoint.

documents.title: Create fine-tuning job
documents.description: Creates a fine-tuning job which begins the process of creating a new model from a given dataset. Response includes details of the enqueued job including job status and the name of the fine-tuned models once complete. [Learn more about fine-tuning](/docs/guides/model-optimization)
